title: Unit orientations under linear maps: |ξ(α∘L)| ≤ |α|_E·‖L‖ⁿ, and invariance when L fixes the oriented plane
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, Q ⊆ ℝ^P a linear subspace, ξ an n-vector (MultiVector P n, a continuous linear functional on n-covectors) that is a unit orientation of Q (IsUnitOrientationOf ξ Q: there are an orthonormal family τ = (τ₁, …, τₙ) with span τ = Q and a sign s ∈ {1, −1} such that ξ(β) = s·β(τ₁, …, τₙ) for every n-covector β), and L : ℝ^P → ℝ^P a continuous linear map. For an n-covector α let α∘L be the n-covector (v₁, …, vₙ) ↦ α(Lv₁, …, Lvₙ) (α.compContinuousLinearMap L). Then (a) |ξ(α∘L)| ≤ |α|_E·‖L‖ⁿ for every n-covector α, where |·|_E is the Euclidean coefficient norm (covectorEuclideanNorm) and ‖L‖ the operator norm; and (b) if Lv = v for every v ∈ Q, then ξ(α∘L) = ξ(α) for every n-covector α.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ξ : MultiVector P n) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (L : Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid P), IsUnitOrientationOf ξ Q → (∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, |ξ (α.compContinuousLinearMap L)| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α * ‖L‖ ^ n) ∧ ((∀ v ∈ Q, L v = v) → ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, ξ (α.compContinuousLinearMap L) = ξ α)
